thread:
Maria Chen: heads-up — noticed a ~6 hour hole in telemetry aggregates for EU-1 from ~02:00-08:00 UTC. graphs drop to 0 for some tenant cohorts :eyes:
Samir Patel: ugh. any idea root cause? kafka lag?
Maria Chen: looks like a flurry of late S3 writes + our ingest lambda timed out during a deploy window. logs show a few 504s and then replay backpressure.
Jon Wright: timeline? was there an infra deploy around 02:10?
Maria Chen: yes, infra deploy at 02:08 rolled a critical netty bump. producers stalled for ~5m then caught up but consumer checkpointing missed a window.
Priya Rao: so data arrived late to ingest, and our recompute jobs never picked it up because replayer uses arrival_time < job_window_end predicate.
Samir Patel: that predicate is bite-sized but lousy for late arrivals. we should run a backfill for affected hours.
Maria Chen: agreed. my immediate ask: can we spin a targeted backfill via console for tenant cohorts with missing aggregates? want to limit to 02:00-08:00 and only EU shards.
console-prod: reminder — console currently exposes backfill range UI + tenant filters. dry-run flag exists but doesn't persist outputs.
Jon Wright: two UX asks: 1) make dry-run visible in audit log, 2) show estimated cost and token count before enqueueing. both help ops decide if we should throttle.
Priya Rao: also need a cancellation token for long replays. we had one taking 12h last month and it kept eating quota because someone forgot to cancel.
Samir Patel: +1 on cancellation. also add a preflight that simulates apply and returns `affected_keys_count` and `estimated_recompute_seconds` so we can route to dedicated capacity if needed.
Maria Chen: do we have tooling to route heavy replays to dedicated pool? or is that manual?
Jon Wright: routing currently mayary. we have policy `replay.priority=high` -> dedicated if capacity available else queue. we can toggle priority on console per-run (manual checkbox).
Priya Rao: TL;DR: plan: 1) run console dry-run for EU 02:00-08:00, tenants filtered by `tenant_tag:audience=paid`, 2) review estimated cost & affected keys, 3) if within budget, submit with priority high and cancellation window 6h, 4) monitor telemetry SLO dashboard and abort if errors spike.
Samir Patel: who owns step 1?
Maria Chen: I'll run the dry-run now and paste results.
Maria Chen: (paste) ```json
{
  "affected_tenants": 14,
  "affected_shards": 6,
  "affected_keys_est": 142k,
  "estimated_recompute_seconds": 5200,
  "estimated_cost_usd": 18.40
}
```
Jon Wright: cost looks fine. 5200s -> ~1.4h on dedicated pool if parallelized. otherwise could be 6-8h on shared. set priority high.
Priya Rao: set `max_concurrent_shards=4` and `cancellation_timeout=6h` on the run. also add `--safe-sync` to ensure we don't overwrite post-run if more late data appears.
Samir Patel: question: does the backfill pipeline dedupe by event_id? we don't want double-counts if some late events already processed.
Maria Chen: yes, replayer has idempotency via (event_id, watermark). but the aggregate recompute step is windowed; we re-aggregate raw events so idempotency is safe.
console-prod: note: running with `priority=high` will consume dedicated capacity tokens. if capacity isn't available the job will queue and alert `replay-ops`.
Jon Wright: let's add a small console change request: after dry-run, surface a one-click `Promote to Run` button that prepopulates the recommended params (priority, concurrency, cancel window). reduces copy-paste errors.
Priya Rao: also add a post-run `smoke-check` step that compares pre/post aggregate counts and flags >0.1% diffs for manual review.
Samir Patel: agree. otherwise we might hide regressions.
Maria Chen: starting the promote flow now. will tag `#replay-ops` and ping when queued.
infra-bot: deploy note — queued replay job 0x9f3b enqueued, priority=high, concurrency=4, cancel_after=6h. link: https://console.internal/replays/0x9f3b
Samir Patel: thanks. I'll watch the SLO dashboard, ping if latency or error rate >2x baseline.
Jon Wright: action items: Maria run & monitor (owner), Jon add Promote-to-Run UX ticket, Priya add smoke-check script, Samir observe SLOs & abort if needed.
Maria Chen: thanks all. will update thread with run outcome. :thumbsup:
